description: Find people matching an ideal customer profile. mode "count" returns the number of matches for free; "market" adds a free breakdown by country, seniority, employer size, industry and title; "people" returns rows at $0.95 per 1,000 (name, title, seniority, employer, location, LinkedIn URL, email flags). Always count first, then ask the user before switching to "people". No live LinkedIn pages are read.

currentRoleStartedAfterDate.description: Job changers: current role started after this month

employerIndustries.description: Industry names of the current employer (Software Development, Financial Services)

maxChargeUsd.description: Maximum spend for this call in USD (default 5); the run stops at the cap and rows already delivered are the only ones charged

mode.description: count and market are free; people is paid per row

pastEmployerDomains.description: People who used to work at these companies

titleKeywords.description: Words in the current job title
